Container.Name: mcp-wrangler

Branch.TagDescription: v0.3.0 - Middleware pipeline, invite tokens, CLI onboarding
v0.2.3 - Fix Docker API version negotiation for older hosts

Container.Overview: MCP Wrangler is a management proxy for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. It sits between your AI tools (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, etc.) and your MCP servers, providing a single authenticated endpoint that handles Docker container lifecycle, health monitoring, OAuth flows, access control, and multi-transport proxying. Manage all your MCP servers from one web UI.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the MCP Wrangler web UI and API proxy.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Docker socket for managing MCP server containers (stdio and HTTP server types).

Config.Name: Encryption Key
Config.Description: Encrypts stored credentials (OAuth tokens, API keys, env vars). Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32. IMPORTANT: Do not lose this key - encrypted data becomes unreadable without it.

Config.Name: Session Secret
Config.Description: Signs web UI session cookies. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Password for the admin web UI account (only used on first run to create the admin user).

Config.Name: Database Path
Config.Description: Path to SQLite database inside the container.

Config.Name: Base URL
Config.Description: External URL for OAuth callbacks and install scripts (e.g., https://mcp.yourdomain.com). Required for OAuth and invite token onboarding. Leave blank for http://localhost:PORT.
